$comment: Full end-to-end: the real Azure, Octopus and Coralogix adapters, pointed at local
emulators. Only the base URLs differ from a production file — the providers, their
mapping, their paging and their auth are the production code paths.
bun run db:up        # Postgres and floci-az
bun run seed:azure   # floci-az starts empty; without this the estate is blank
bun run dev:stack    # Octopus, Coralogix and the Azure cost mock
SOURCES_ALLOW_FIXTURES is needed because the Azure provider declares three of the nine
cloud capabilities: regions, nodes and spend are in ARM, and the other six —
utilisation, storage, databases, queues, alerts — are Azure Monitor readings that
floci-az does not emulate. The fixture cloud is not connected alongside it (loadConnections
refuses a fixture beside a real source of the same kind), so those six render as stated
gaps. Set it to false once a Monitor mock exists.
